subject: Reminds me of my first
author: oO EezO Oo
body:
I had played the offline campaign for a few months cuz I didn't have my internet hooked up yet.  So I finally get set up on xbox live, first game I go for is Burnout.  I hop into my first ever online race,  I got my favorite car the Black Elite and everyone else has this goofy Revenge Racer thing.  I'm thinkin to myself   *I'm gonna smoke these guys, they wont even know what hit em*   Then the countdown goes....     3....2....1.... GO    now I'm thinking  "Holy Crap!!!!!   Where the Eff did they go?!?!?!"   Dang, that was an eye-opener.  I thought the offline game was quick but seein those cars flying like that online is what really got me hooked.  I wish I had the presence of mind to remember those gamertags, I'd love to catch a race with em now.  Now my favorite part of the game is how you can learn something new everytime you sign on.

" Ooh ooh ooh......VERTICAL.......sweeeeeeeeeeet! "
